error.name: ambiguous_spec
error.example:
# BAD - Ambiguous Steps: 1. Do the login thing 2. Check it works
# GOOD - Clear Steps: 1. Enter "admin" in username field 2. Enter "password123" in password field 3. Click Sign In button
Expected Results: - User is redirected to /dashboard - Welcome message displays "Welcome, admin"

error.name: missing_coverage
error.description: Test scenarios don't cover all acceptance criteria

solutions.solution: Map each acceptance criterion to test scenarios
Include positive, negative, and edge cases

steps.step: List all acceptance criteria from user story
Map each criterion to test scenarios
Read spec as if you're a tester receiving it

pattern.name: add_missing_scenario
pattern.description: Add scenario to cover missing criteria

pattern.name: clarify_scenario
pattern.example:
# Before Steps: 1. Test the form
# After Steps: 1. Navigate to /settings page 2. Enter "John Doe" in name field 3. Enter "john@example.com" in email field 4. Click Save button
Expected Results: - Success message displays "Settings saved" - Name field shows "John Doe" - Email field shows "john@example.com"
